description:
Repair Rust API documentation references after the command-family facade moves so the published documentation resolves names to their actual owners.

## Background

The bulk-update documentation names `Self::capture_proposed_base` inside `IssueOps`, but the helper remains on `CommandExecutor`. Command-family comments also contain unqualified type names absent from their module scopes. The facade migrations require intra-doc links to name the resulting paths; passing doctests does not establish that generated API links resolve.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Intra-doc links in the migrated command families resolve to their actual canonical owners, including the bulk-update capture helper and the repository-layout, document-path, projection and profile archive error types.
- [hard] REQ-02: The existing workspace API documentation generation, including private items, completes without unresolved-link diagnostics. Any confirmed residual missing-name or malformed-link references are corrected at their existing comments.
- [hard] REQ-03: The repair changes documentation references only: no runtime behavior, API visibility, imports, forwarding methods, compatibility names, checker mechanisms or lint exemptions are introduced.

## Notes

Use the existing Rustdoc generation workflow as the resolver. Public-only documentation has different visibility diagnostics; do not claim it was verified from the private-items build. Historical warning lists are investigation leads, not current evidence.
title: Rust API links name the owners after facade extraction
